boundaryGate.question: After Alembic commit 9d703a3, does the documented real BiliDili bootstrap reset clear stale Core deepMining measured state so the following in-process deepMining run opens/closes a fresh round and satisfies the P6/G4 gate?
boundaryGate.objectBoundary: Real BiliDili workspace P6 deepMining reset-and-rerun only. Validate Alembic fullReset behavior plus subsequent in-process deepMining round advancement/coverage evidence. Do not test unrelated P7+ phases or change product code.
controllerSelfChecks: Controller accepted Alembic repair commit 9d703a3 after reviewing source/test diff and rerunning CleanupService unit test, build:check, repo-boundary lint, and diff whitespace.
Previous Test blocker proved stale coverage_ledger/deep_mining_rounds survived bootstrap reset before repair and caused stopReason=diminishing-returns before a fresh round opened.
realScenarioConditions: Use the real BiliDili workspace directly, not a sandbox copy.
Use the configured generation/embedding stack: DeepSeek for generation and local Qwen embedding; do not swap providers.
Start from accepted Alembic commit 9d703a3fa8a6f7cbabb1d02ec5d968e2c399a3d1 and record all repository HEADs used.
Before any destructive reset, re-check the R-2 source triad/root guard so only the intended BiliDili workspace/data root is touched.
Use alembic_bootstrap with rebuild:true between attempts; recipe delete/rebuild is authorized for BiliDili only.
Do not manually repair the database with ad hoc SQL to force success; SQL queries are allowed only for observation/evidence.
successMeans: Post-repair bootstrap rebuild clears stale measured state for the BiliDili project root; after reset, coverage_ledger and deep_mining_rounds no longer contain the pre-repair stale round/coverage rows for that root.
The following in-process deepMining run opens and closes a fresh round; deep_mining_rounds advances from the post-reset baseline and records daemon-job-runner/in-process execution evidence.
The P6/G4 evidence is fresh: coverage evidence after the deepMining run is attributable to the rerun, not carried over from old rows, and the gate is non-empty where required.
Advisor termination is recorded and acceptable for P6, without stopping before the fresh round opens.
Host vs in-process parity predicate for this P6 chain has no unexpected diff, or any diff is precisely attributed and non-blocking by the original P6 acceptance rules.
failureMeans: Bootstrap rebuild still leaves stale coverage_ledger or deep_mining_rounds rows for the BiliDili root.
The post-reset deepMining run completes without opening/closing a fresh round, or max round/round count does not advance from the reset baseline.
Coverage evidence remains stale or empty in a way that fails G4/P6.
The run touches the wrong root, wrong provider stack, sandbox copy, unrelated workspace, or manually forces database success.
A product/runtime error prevents a real P6 conclusion and must be returned with raw logs and exact failure stage.
cannotConclude: Do not conclude P7+ or whole demand completion from this rerun.
Do not conclude coldStart writes measured coverage; the confirmed decision is still that coldStart does not write measured coverage.
Do not treat manual SQL cleanup as proof of product behavior.
Do not treat provider fallback, mocked AI, or sandbox-copy results as equivalent to the required real BiliDili run.
Do not accept a non-empty coverage table unless the evidence distinguishes fresh post-run rows from stale pre-reset rows.
stopConditions: R-2/root guard cannot prove the intended BiliDili data root before destructive reset.
Configured DeepSeek/Qwen provider stack is unavailable or would be swapped.
Bootstrap rebuild or deepMining fails before producing reviewable logs/DB evidence.
The run would touch the real ~/.asd outside the authorized BiliDili workspace/data root boundary.
Any evidence suggests the wrong repository commit or state root is being tested.

evidenceRequired: Repository HEADs and provider configuration used for the run.
Pre-reset, post-bootstrap-reset, and post-deepMining DB summaries for coverage_ledger/deep_mining_rounds scoped to BiliDili project root.
Job ids, run JSON, logs, and stopReason for bootstrap and deepMining.
Explicit round advancement proof: baseline round state after reset versus post-run state.
Coverage freshness proof showing post-run non-empty evidence is not stale carryover.
R-2/root guard notes and any host/in-process parity diff report.
allowedOperations: Run real BiliDili bootstrap rebuild and deepMining in the authorized workspace.
Delete/rebuild BiliDili recipe artifacts as required by documented bootstrap rebuild.
Capture reports under Test/tmp and state-root evidence.
forbiddenOperations: Do not edit Alembic, AlembicCore, AlembicPlugin, AlembicAgent, or BiliDili product code.
Do not push, release, version bump, or change vendor pointers.
Do not manually mutate the database to force passing rows.
Do not touch unrelated ~/.asd workspaces or sandbox copies.
